name: A. Garrett, auctioneer
trade: auction of town lots and land

proprietors.name: A. Garrett
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card garrett_a (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names Dearborn Street and nothing narrower; the paper gives no anchor.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1835-08-22, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
